entries.290f0d7ce5de5dcc: Its basic management policy is to respect Japan's food culture: using high-quality rice harvested in Japan as its raw material, to manufacture authentic 'gohan' and 'mochi' that recreate traditional methods with its own technology, and to supply them to consumers nationwide. In the medium to long term, the company says it will build on three brands, 'Sato no Gohan', 'Sato no Kirimochi' and 'Usagimochi', and pursue higher value added as well as growth investment to improve quality, taste and production volume.
entries.2b66939fc622ed5a: The core of its strategy is to reduce the seasonal fluctuation of packaged mochi, for which demand is concentrated at year-end, by expanding sales of packaged cooked rice and stimulating year-round demand for packaged mochi. In packaged cooked rice, the company launched the new product 'Sato no Gohan Shin Teiban' in February 2026. The second plant at the Seiro Factory completed its building in April 2026, with production scheduled to begin in December 2026. Capacity expansion and the introduction of new products are under way.
entries.37cdfa23fb0ce5ea: Even as domestic rice consumption declines year by year, the packaged cooked rice market continues to grow, and its value as emergency food in disasters is also rising. Of the company's group revenue of ¥51,775 million, packaged cooked rice products account for ¥32,871 million and packaged mochi products for ¥18,882 million, and sales are made only in Japan. Its principal customers are food wholesalers and trading companies, and four companies are shown in the information by principal customer.
